desc.zh: 把 DSH 变成一条活在聊天软件里的大肥鱼：有人设、记得住人、能自己去 B 站翻东西。通道按你混的社区选，选一个就够。
desc.en: Turn DSH into a persona living inside your chat apps: it knows who it talks to, remembers them, and can browse Bilibili on its own.

hint.zh: 至少选一个 —— 你混哪个社区就选哪个，也可以都要
hint.en: Pick at least one — choose where you hang out, or take several
